description.short_caption: Dark necrotic lesion on the finger with surrounding erythema.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows a dark, necrotic lesion on the finger, surrounded by erythematous tissue. The lesion appears well-demarcated with a central black eschar and peripheral redness, suggesting tissue necrosis and inflammation. The image is focused on the distal phalanx, and the surrounding skin texture is visible.
